I'm Truc Nguyen, based in Ho Chi Minh City. Marketing, to me, sits at the intersection of human insight, data patterns, and business goals — and that's exactly where I operate.

I specialise in growth through content strategy and product-led campaigns, while building the internal systems that help teams perform consistently. Whether I'm leading a campaign or designing a workflow, I care just as much about what runs behind the scenes as what shows up in the feed.

Expertise · Polaris Academy
Brand Strategy

Brand
Positioning

Client Polaris Academy
Timeline April – September 2025
Role Project Lead
Industry English Education
Background

The challenge.

🧩 Fragmented identity

The brand had a name and basic visual identity, but they were not implemented consistently — resulting in fragmented recognition across all touchpoints.

🏆 Fierce competition

The English education market has over 1,000 rivals in Vietnam. Without clear positioning and a standout USP, it is difficult to differentiate and remain memorable.

Scope of work

Key responsibilities.

Market research & customer insights — mapping audience mindsets, pain points, and decision drivers
Building the brand positioning framework — defining brand purpose, personality, and differentiation pillars
Completing the messaging system & USP — creating a coherent verbal identity from tagline to content tone
Proposing a synchronized communication strategy — aligning all channels with the new positioning
Results

Facebook performance.

Significant growth in brand awareness and engagement following the implementation of re-positioning and integrated communication strategies.

Metric Before After Growth
Followers 621 4,674 ↑ 653%
Engagement 1,004 15,536 ↑ 1,448%
Page Visits 5,665 20,697 ↑ 265%
